# Bump Compass

> Free pregnancy calculators and week-by-week guides. Every clinical claim is sourced to ACOG, NICHD, Mayo Clinic, or NHS; where authorities disagree, the range is shown. All tools run in the browser and nothing is stored. Not medical advice.

Bump Compass is a content and tools site for pregnancy, with two content types:

- **Calculators** — interactive tools that compute dates and milestones from user input, entirely client-side. There is no calculators API.
- **Guides** — long-form, sourced articles explaining pregnancy topics.

Key facts for agents:

- Calculators are pure client-side JavaScript. Inputs never leave the browser and nothing is persisted.
- The only backend endpoint is the email signup behind the free PDF download (a Cloudflare Function).
- Content is evidence-based: clinical claims are cited inline, and ranges are shown where authorities disagree.
- Pages are server-rendered (Astro) with semantic HTML and a well-formed accessibility tree.

## Calculators

- [Gestational Age Calculator](https://bumpcompass.com/gestational-age-calculator/): Weeks and days pregnant from LMP, due date, or ultrasound.
- [How Many Weeks Pregnant](https://bumpcompass.com/how-many-weeks-pregnant/): Gestational age in conversational form.
- [Trimester Calculator](https://bumpcompass.com/trimester-calculator/): Which trimester, by ACOG boundaries.
- [Conception Date Calculator](https://bumpcompass.com/conception-date-calculator/): Estimated conception and fertile window.
- [Pregnancy Milestone Dates](https://bumpcompass.com/pregnancy-milestone-dates/): Dated list of key milestones.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://bumpcompass.com/due-date-calculator/): EDD from LMP, conception, IVF transfer, or ultrasound.
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://bumpcompass.com/ovulation-calculator/): Ovulation date and fertile window from cycle length.
- [Pregnancy Test Tracker](https://bumpcompass.com/pregnancy-test-tracker/): hCG levels and what results mean.
- [Kick Counter](https://bumpcompass.com/kick-counter/): Track fetal movements from week 28 onward.

## Guides

- [First Trimester](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/first-trimester/): Weeks 1-13, symptoms, development, screening.
- [Second Trimester](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/second-trimester/): Weeks 14-27, movement, anatomy scan.
- [Third Trimester](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/third-trimester/): Weeks 28-40, monitoring, birth preparation.
- [Prenatal Vitamins](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/prenatal-vitamins/): Key nutrients and how to choose a prenatal vitamin.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/pregnancy-weight-gain/): Weight gain guidelines by pre-pregnancy BMI.
- [Fetal Development](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/fetal-development/): Week-by-week development from embryo to term.
- [Pregnancy Week by Week](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/pregnancy-week-by-week/): Body and baby changes each week.
- [Gestational Age Explained](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/gestational-age-explained/): Why dating counts from the last period.
- [Due Date Explained](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/due-date-explained/): How due dates are calculated and their accuracy.
- [Pregnancy Test Timing](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/pregnancy-test-timing/): When to test for the most accurate result.
- [Sleep During Pregnancy](https://bumpcompass.com/guides/sleep-during-pregnancy/): Why sleep changes, safe sleep positions, and how to rest better.
